exercise.prompt:
Referee a guessing game. The first line is the secret number; then come guesses, one per line, until one is right.
1. For each wrong guess, print `Too high` or `Too low`.
2. For the right guess, print `Got it in N tries`, or `Got it in 1 try` when the first guess was right.
Hint: keep reading guesses with `prompt()` inside a `while` loop.
exercise.promptHi:
Ek guessing game ke referee bano. Pehli line secret number hai; phir guesses aate hain, har line mein ek, jab tak ek sahi na ho.
1. Har galat guess par `Too high` ya `Too low` print karo.
2. Sahi guess par `Got it in N tries` print karo, ya agar pehla guess hi sahi tha toh `Got it in 1 try`.
Hint: `while` loop ke andar `prompt()` se guesses padhte raho.
